content: Trees and Binary Search Trees. Tree terminology: root, parent, child, leaf. BST property: left subtree values are smaller and right subtree values are larger. In-order traversal of a BST visits keys in sorted order.
AVL Trees. Balance factor = height(left) - height(right). Valid balance factors are -1, 0, and 1. Rotations restore balance after insertion or deletion.
Rotations. LL case: right rotation. RR case: left rotation. LR and RL cases require double rotations.

Hypothesis Testing. Null hypothesis H0 and alternative hypothesis H1 must be defined before the test. A p-value is compared with the significance level alpha. Do not interpret statistical significance as practical importance.
CSS Flexbox. display: flex creates a flex formatting context. justify-content aligns items on the main axis. align-items aligns items on the cross axis.
Common Flexbox properties include flex-direction, gap, flex-wrap, and align-content.

Technology and Society. Technology shapes institutions and social behaviour. Ethical analysis should consider stakeholders, benefits, harms, and accountability. Platform governance involves rules, moderation, transparency, and user rights.
